title: FM200 and R102 Maintenance and Inspection for Navy Yard Tugs in Yokosuka Japan
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC YOKOSUKA.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR  YOKOSUKA
detail_text: FM200 and R102 Maintenance and Inspection for Navy Yard Tugs YT-804, YT-805, YT-806 and YT-807 This solicitation is intended only for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in Japan, as prescribed by DFARS 252.225-7042. Prime Contractors outside of Japan must submit documentation that unambiguously demonstrates the Offer's compliance with DFARS 252.225-7042 (e.g. proof of incorporation) as part of their offer.
